description: Extract shared types, constants, and utility functions into dedicated modules to reduce duplication and improve maintainability.
steps: 1. Create src/constants.ts with: PRIORITY_OPTIONS array (value + label pairs for P1-P5), STATUS_LABELS record (mapping WatchStatus to display strings like the ones in ShowCard.tsx), STATUS_CYCLE record (mapping each WatchStatus to the next), and DEFAULT_PRIORITY = 3.
2. Create src/utils.ts with: (a) the uid() function currently in App.tsx, (b) the formatProgress() function currently in ShowCard.tsx.

3. In src/types.ts, add a ShowPatch type: { title: string; notes?: string; season?: number; episode?: number } - this is currently duplicated as inline types in ShowCard.tsx Props and ShowList.tsx Props. Also add a type alias Priority = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 and update the Show interface to use it.
4. Update src/App.tsx to import uid from src/utils.ts instead of defining it inline.

5. Update src/components/ShowCard.tsx to: (a) import STATUS_LABELS and STATUS_CYCLE from src/constants.ts (removing the local definitions), (b) import formatProgress from src/utils.ts (removing the local definition), (c) import ShowPatch from src/types.ts and use it in the Props interface for onEdit.
6. Update src/components/ShowList.tsx to import ShowPatch from src/types.ts and use it in the Props interface for onEditShow.
7. Update src/components/AddShowForm.tsx to import DEFAULT_PRIORITY from src/constants.ts instead of hardcoding 3.

8. In src/storage.ts, add runtime validation for the parsed JSON data (similar to the validation pattern already used in ImportExport.tsx). Import and reuse the isValidPlatform/isValidShow validators by extracting them from ImportExport.tsx into a new src/validation.ts module. Update ImportExport.tsx to import from src/validation.ts instead of defining them inline.
9. Rename the Props interface in ImportExport.tsx from ImportExportProps to Props for consistency with all other components that use the name Props.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate type definitions for ShowPatch - it exists only in src/types.ts and is imported elsewhere
uid() is defined only in src/utils.ts and imported by App.tsx
formatProgress() is defined only in src/utils.ts and imported by ShowCard.tsx
STATUS_LABELS and STATUS_CYCLE are defined only in src/constants.ts and imported by ShowCard.tsx
Validation functions (isValidShow, isValidPlatform, validateImportData) live in src/validation.ts and are imported by both storage.ts and ImportExport.tsx
storage.ts loadPlatforms() validates parsed JSON using the shared validators before returning it, falling back to DEFAULTS on invalid data
All existing tests continue to pass (no behavioral changes)
Priority type is a union type 1|2|3|4|5 in types.ts
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit from /projects/sandbox/tv-tracker to confirm type checking passes
Run npx vitest run from /projects/sandbox/tv-tracker to confirm all tests pass
findings: Changed Priority type from number to union type 1|2|3|4|5 in types.ts. This required adding Priority import and 'as Priority' casts in ShowCard.tsx and AddShowForm.tsx where Number(e.target.value) is used. DEFAULT_PRIORITY in constants.ts is explicitly typed as Priority to ensure useState infers the correct type.
